description: Submit a stay booking request on behalf of a real guest — check_room_availability shows whether the dates are free; the venue's city/countryCode come from search_venues. This is a REQUEST the venue reviews and confirms (same as a guest booking on the website), not an instant confirmation. No payment is collected by this tool. If the venue takes a deposit, it is requested after the venue confirms the room.
name: book_room
title: Request a room booking
